text: Performance claim scope: JMH setup constructs all axes, evidence, schedules, queries, and policies at Trial level. The relational methods both call public RelationalFit.query for one source identity and one RDM estimand; only explicit dense materialization versus matrix-free projection differs, and setup plus JVM/JS laws prove numerical identity. Scala.js has deterministic work laws only and no timing claim. JMH numbers are exact-host diagnostics, never thresholds.
